description: Calls and contract details the products need that the Ever Platform API contract does not carry yet. Each entry is answered by the mock platform and documented in the outbound-call table as pending upstream; it moves into contracts/openapi/ever-platform.v1.yaml when the platform contract publishes it. Request schemas here are closed and follow the outbound-call table.

responses.200: the state is enabled (accepted) or the consent is revoked (declined)
the grant, with the invitee's name and e-mail only after the provider person accepted it
responses.409: illegal_transition (the grant is not accepted yet)

problem_codes.why: a statistics report whose Ever-Stats-Signature does not verify over the received bytes; the platform's ErrorCode enum does not list it yet

StatsLinkCreate.why: two keys per installation: the link statement is signed with the separate statistics key and sent under the connect-key token, so the body carries the statistics public key and the statement; the design schema still has the one-key shape

schema.description: The two-key link statement. `statement_sig` is a compact JWS (header `{alg: EdDSA, typ: ever-stats-link+jwt}`) signed with the statistics key whose payload is `{stats_instance_id, stats_public_jwk, iat}`; the body repeats `stats_instance_id` and `stats_public_jwk`, which must equal the payload, and `iat` must be within 10 minutes of the server clock. The statistics key must be the one pinned for `stats_instance_id` by the first accepted report.
